company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform that enables developers to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services. It simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so teams can create better APIs faster.
target_audience: Software developers, API engineers, development teams, and enterprise organizations seeking to build, test, manage, and distribute APIs at scale.
leadership_names: Abhinav Asthana; Ankit Sobti; Abhijit Kane

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative that provides a Postgres-based development platform with authentication, APIs, edge functions, storage, realtime, and vector embeddings. It enables developers to build and scale applications quickly, serving millions of users worldwide.
target_audience: Developers and product teams building AI-powered applications, from indie hackers to enterprise innovation teams, who need a scalable Postgres backend with integrated auth, storage, edge functions, and realtime capabilities.

company_overview: Vapi is a platform that enables builders to create, deploy, and improve voice AI agents with orchestration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise-grade configurability. It serves enterprises and developers by providing scalable infrastructure, integrations, and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI) to support high-volume voice applications.
target_audience: Vapi's ideal customers are developers and enterprises seeking to build, deploy, and scale voice AI agents, particularly in sectors such as automotive, healthcare, marketplace, and staffing that require high-volume, compliant voice interactions.
